properties.notes: Site is situated in a highly sustainable location on the edge of the city centre adjacent to key regeneration proposals. Redevelopment of the site offers an opportunity to increase the vitality of the city centre and provide a suitable residential environment. Permission is for 145 apartments over 2 parts of the site and 84 student cluster flats. - Aggregated as 61 dwellings.
